title: Exact augmented restricted associated-sheaf resolution
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, W an open of Spec R and I an injective resolution of the R-module R [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. There is a quasi-isomorphism from the degree-zero complex of the underlying abelian structure sheaf on W to the complex obtained by applying [new-punctured-restricted-abelian-functor] to I. This statement asserts exactness before taking sections and asserts no comparison of cohomology groups.

source.place: Tags 01I6 and 0A6T; associated sheaves, restriction and exactness

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.tilde_preserves_finite_limits to obtain finite-limit preservation by the associated-sheaf functor. Its left adjunction supplies finite-colimit preservation.

Open restriction preserves limits and is a left adjoint, hence preserves finite colimits. The abelian forgetful functor also preserves finite limits and colimits. Their composite therefore preserves homology and the resolution augmentation remains a quasi-isomorphism. Compose its source with the single-complex transport of the canonical tildeSelf and restrictUnitIso identifications. This constructs the augmentation in the theorem, with no sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_tilde_resolution_exact
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    ∃ ι : (CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶
        ((puncturedRestrictedAbelianFunctor R W).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex,
      QuasiIso ι
